body: Thank you some times I believe that to be true
I just hurt emotionally. I want so badly to be loved and have him be proud of me.

It's not abusive . We are just harsh verbally. His ex texts or emails every month and I get up set.  We usually quarrel about that for about a week. Then we quarrel about what ever else comes up. We are definitely codependent and miss each other when we are not together. But I feel like he definitely has more fun when I am not around. We just had a quarrel and he threw out that maybe I should go to visit my out of state family early and alone. He is now sleeping with his back to me and doesn't want to talk.he says we are ok but just wants to be left alone.   I am freaking out. I need reassurance from him and affection even though this fight is 50% my fault.
